items.title: ROA x C.P. Company Announce First Collaboration
items.summary: Italian footwear brand ROA and Italian luxury sportswear brand C.P. Company have announced their first collaborative collection. items.title: TOGA Drops Limited-Edition Sweatshirts Reimagining Champion's Reverse Weave
items.summary: TOGA, the label helmed by Yasuko Furuta, has unveiled an exclusive collection with American athletic wear brand Champion. The release features two styles—a crewneck sweatshirt and a hoodie—that take the authentic silhouette of Champion’s signature Reverse Weave as their base, updated with boldly printed, colorful TOGA logos.Reverse Weave is Champion’s proprietary construction method that prevents vertical shrinkage by cutting the fabric on the cross-grain rather than the standard vertical grain, while utilizing expansion gussets on the sides to manage horizontal shrinkage. items.title: Stone Island’s Milan Flagship Is a Material Research Lab in Its Own Right
items.summary: Summary Stone Island reunites with OMA/AMO to renovate and expand its 600-square-meter Milan flagship.Burnt cork, handmade fused glass, and recycled resin translate the brand’s garment research into architectural experimentation.Seven independent designers and creative studios contribute furniture, lighting, display objects, and sound systems to the space. What happens when you apply the same curiosity that goes into developing a Stone Island jacket to the design of an entire building’s interior?
